wrong.oewn-02042744-a.label: negative

family.axis: a wrong opinion recorded → conduct deserving severe censure

wrong.oewn-02042744-a.tone: The family's flat verdict, condemning without heat and reaching conscience, morality and law with the same single word.

condemnable.oewn-02043172-s.label: negative

family.axis: a wrong opinion recorded → conduct deserving severe censure

condemnable.oewn-02043172-s.tone: States the desert rather than colouring it - the thing has earned rebuke, and the word says so and stops.

criminal.oewn-02043172-s.label: negative

family.axis: a wrong opinion recorded → conduct deserving severe censure

criminal.oewn-02043172-s.tone: Puts the weight of a legal charge behind a censure that is moral rather than legal, which makes it an outcry where *condemnable* is a ruling.

deplorable.oewn-02043172-s.label: negative

family.axis: a wrong opinion recorded → conduct deserving severe censure

deplorable.oewn-02043172-s.tone: Voices the disapproval as dismay - the thing is bad enough to be lamented, not merely bad enough to be rebuked.

reprehensible.oewn-02043172-s.label: negative

family.axis: a wrong opinion recorded → conduct deserving severe censure

reprehensible.oewn-02043172-s.tone: Formal and judicial in weight, handing the blame down as a finding rather than an outburst - the cold end of *criminal*.

vicious.oewn-02043172-s.label: negative

family.axis: a wrong opinion recorded → conduct deserving severe censure

vicious.oewn-02043172-s.tone: Puts the fault in the thing itself rather than in the verdict on it, imputing wickedness where *reprehensible* only assigns blame.

base.oewn-02043484-s.label: negative

family.axis: a wrong opinion recorded → conduct deserving severe censure

base.oewn-02043484-s.tone: Contemptuous - it ranks the character as low, not merely at fault, where *immoral* records the failure and leaves the person's standing alone.

immoral.oewn-02043484-s.label: negative

family.axis: a wrong opinion recorded → conduct deserving severe censure

immoral.oewn-02043484-s.tone: The flat categorical charge: measured against a standard and found outside it, with the force sitting in the standard rather than in the tone.

misguided.oewn-02043804-s.label: negative

family.axis: a wrong opinion recorded → conduct deserving severe censure

misguided.oewn-02043804-s.tone: Faults the judgment while leaving the intention unblamed - being led wrong is a softer charge than being wrong.

mistaken.oewn-02043804-s.label: neutral

family.axis: a wrong opinion recorded → conduct deserving severe censure

mistaken.oewn-02043804-s.tone: Records the error and nothing else, no reproach attaching, where *misguided* still suggests the opinion was badly arrived at.

artificial.oewn-01575756-a.label: neutral

family.axis: plainly made rather than natural → so made it has no substance behind it

artificial.oewn-01575756-a.tone: The family's flat baseline: it says a thing was contrived rather than grown and stops there, where *unreal* goes on to deny it.

unreal.oewn-01575756-a.label: negative

family.axis: plainly made rather than natural → so made it has no substance behind it

unreal.oewn-01575756-a.tone: Sets the made thing against the natural one, so what it withholds is naturalness rather than existence.

arranged.oewn-01576262-s.label: negative

family.axis: plainly made rather than natural → so made it has no substance behind it

arranged.oewn-01576262-s.tone: Names the deliberation and no more — the effect was composed, which is a fact before it is a complaint.

staged.oewn-01576262-s.label: negative

family.axis: plainly made rather than natural → so made it has no substance behind it

staged.oewn-01576262-s.tone: Makes that arrangement a performance put on for an onlooker, so what looked spontaneous reads as put-up — the accusation *arranged* stops short of.

bionic.oewn-01576402-s.label: neutral

family.axis: plainly made rather than natural → so made it has no substance behind it

bionic.oewn-01576402-s.tone: Strictly technical — it reports function augmented or replaced by machinery and carries none of the deficiency the rest of the family hangs on the made.

bleached.oewn-01576564-s.label: negative

family.axis: plainly made rather than natural → so made it has no substance behind it

bleached.oewn-01576564-s.tone: Colour got by stripping rather than adding, and the word keeps the drained, washed-out feel of that.

colored.oewn-01576564-s.label: neutral

family.axis: plainly made rather than natural → so made it has no substance behind it

colored.oewn-01576564-s.tone: The blankest of these — the colour was put there, with no hint of how or how deep.

coloured.oewn-01576564-s.label: neutral

family.axis: plainly made rather than natural → so made it has no substance behind it

coloured.oewn-01576564-s.tone: The British spelling, identical in force to *colored*: applied colour, stated without comment.

dyed.oewn-01576564-s.label: neutral

family.axis: plainly made rather than natural → so made it has no substance behind it

dyed.oewn-01576564-s.tone: Puts the colour in deep rather than on the surface, more concrete than *colored* and no harsher for it.

cardboard.oewn-01576718-s.label: negative

family.axis: plainly made rather than natural → so made it has no substance behind it

cardboard.oewn-01576718-s.tone: Withering — the thing is flat, propped up, and has nothing behind it.

unlifelike.oewn-01576718-s.label: negative

family.axis: plainly made rather than natural → so made it has no substance behind it

unlifelike.oewn-01576718-s.tone: A plain report of the shortfall, measuring the thing against life and finding it thin, with none of *cardboard*'s contempt.

celluloid.oewn-01576851-s.label: negative

family.axis: plainly made rather than natural → so made it has no substance behind it

celluloid.oewn-01576851-s.tone: Gives the thing the sheen of a screen image and the same nothing behind the surface.

synthetic.oewn-01576851-s.label: negative

family.axis: plainly made rather than natural → so made it has no substance behind it

synthetic.oewn-01576851-s.tone: Manufactured-feeling rather than lived — the same screen-thin unreality as *celluloid*, without the sheen.

conventionalized.oewn-01576997-s.label: negative

family.axis: plainly made rather than natural → so made it has no substance behind it

conventionalized.oewn-01576997-s.tone: Says the form was settled by convention rather than felt in the moment — cool and analytic, a shortfall of spontaneity rather than of substance.

conventionalised.oewn-01576997-s.label: negative

family.axis: plainly made rather than natural → so made it has no substance behind it

conventionalised.oewn-01576997-s.tone: The British spelling, carrying exactly the measured, analytic weight of *conventionalized*.

stylized.oewn-01576997-s.label: neutral

family.axis: plainly made rather than natural → so made it has no substance behind it

stylized.oewn-01576997-s.tone: The one here that can name a deliberate artistic manner rather than a failure, where *unlifelike* is only a falling short.

imperfect.oewn-01756665-a.label: negative

family.axis: bare shortfall from perfect → a fault that spoils and discredits the thing

imperfect.oewn-01756665-a.tone: The plain word for falling short of perfect - it states the shortfall and stops there, without *defective*'s implication that something inside has gone wrong.

blemished.oewn-01757051-s.label: negative

family.axis: bare shortfall from perfect → a fault that spoils and discredits the thing

blemished.oewn-01757051-s.tone: Puts the fault on the surface - a mark on something otherwise sound, where *flawed* lets the fault run through it.

flawed.oewn-01757051-s.label: negative

family.axis: bare shortfall from perfect → a fault that spoils and discredits the thing

flawed.oewn-01757051-s.tone: The same defect read as structural rather than a spot, which is why it lands harder than *blemished*.

broken.oewn-01757160-s.label: negative

family.axis: bare shortfall from perfect → a fault that spoils and discredits the thing

broken.oewn-01757160-s.tone: Grades speech or writing as falling short of fluent - a shortfall in the language itself, not *defective*'s fault built into a thing.

broken.oewn-00738739-s.label: neutral

family.axis: partly spoiled but still there → reduced to nothing

broken.oewn-00738739-s.tone: Financial ruin in the bluntest available word - a single snap rather than a decline, and it reports the loss without blaming the one it fell on.

corrupt.oewn-01757260-s.label: negative

family.axis: bare shortfall from perfect → a fault that spoils and discredits the thing

corrupt.oewn-01757260-s.tone: Says errors and alterations have got in, so the thing can no longer be trusted as it stands - heavier than *flawed*, which admits a fault without unsettling the whole.

corrupted.oewn-01757260-s.label: negative

family.axis: bare shortfall from perfect → a fault that spoils and discredits the thing

corrupted.oewn-01757260-s.tone: The participle points back at a sound original that errors have since entered, where *corrupt* simply reports the state.

defective.oewn-01757421-s.label: negative

family.axis: bare shortfall from perfect → a fault that spoils and discredits the thing

defective.oewn-01757421-s.tone: Names the defect as a verdict on the whole item - colder and more final than *faulty*.

faulty.oewn-01757421-s.label: negative

family.axis: bare shortfall from perfect → a fault that spoils and discredits the thing

faulty.oewn-01757421-s.tone: Workaday and remediable - it locates a fault to be put right rather than writing the thing off the way *defective* does.

imperfectible.oewn-01757608-s.label: neutral

family.axis: bare shortfall from perfect → a fault that spoils and discredits the thing

imperfectible.oewn-01757608-s.tone: Purely a statement of capacity - it says imperfection could be introduced and passes no judgement, where *defective* and *corrupt* both condemn.

irregular.oewn-01757717-s.label: negative

family.axis: bare shortfall from perfect → a fault that spoils and discredits the thing

irregular.oewn-01757717-s.tone: Grades an item as missing the standard of manufacture, registering the imperfection while cushioning it - far short of calling it *defective*.

successful.oewn-02339254-a.label: positive

family.axis: a favorable outcome stated as plain fact → success loud enough to be proclaimed

successful.oewn-02339254-a.tone: The family's flat statement that the outcome went well, carrying none of the swagger *boffo* brings to the same result.

boffo.oewn-02339713-s.label: positive

family.axis: a favorable outcome stated as plain fact → success loud enough to be proclaimed

boffo.oewn-02339713-s.tone: Informal and exuberant - a hit rather than a result, success that arrives with applause attached.

booming.oewn-02339849-s.label: positive

family.axis: a favorable outcome stated as plain fact → success loud enough to be proclaimed

booming.oewn-02339849-s.tone: Profit heard as noise, busy enough to be audible, where *flourishing* keeps its liveliness quiet.

flourishing.oewn-02339849-s.label: positive

family.axis: a favorable outcome stated as plain fact → success loud enough to be proclaimed

flourishing.oewn-02339849-s.tone: Liveliness figured as healthy growth, organic where *booming* is loud.

palmy.oewn-02339849-s.label: positive

family.axis: a favorable outcome stated as plain fact → success loud enough to be proclaimed

palmy.oewn-02339849-s.tone: Ornate and faintly grand, giving profitable liveliness a costume that *thriving* does without.

prospering.oewn-02339849-s.label: positive

family.axis: a favorable outcome stated as plain fact → success loud enough to be proclaimed

prospering.oewn-02339849-s.tone: The participle keeps the gain in motion - still climbing, where *prosperous* names a state already reached.

prosperous.oewn-02339849-s.label: positive

family.axis: a favorable outcome stated as plain fact → success loud enough to be proclaimed

prosperous.oewn-02339849-s.tone: Settled rather than surging: comfortable profit as a condition, not a rush.

roaring.oewn-02339849-s.label: positive

family.axis: a favorable outcome stated as plain fact → success loud enough to be proclaimed

roaring.oewn-02339849-s.tone: The loudest word in the set - profit at full volume, and it refuses to be understated.

thriving.oewn-02339849-s.label: positive

family.axis: a favorable outcome stated as plain fact → success loud enough to be proclaimed

thriving.oewn-02339849-s.tone: Vitality as the measure of profit, doing well the way a living thing does and with none of *roaring*'s noise.

burgeoning.oewn-02339849-s.label: positive

family.axis: a favorable outcome stated as plain fact → success loud enough to be proclaimed

burgeoning.oewn-02339849-s.tone: Swelling growth caught mid-expansion, promising more where *prosperous* implies arrival.

in.oewn-02340196-s.label: neutral

family.axis: a favorable outcome stated as plain fact → success loud enough to be proclaimed

in.oewn-02340196-s.tone: Purely positional - it records that the office is held and passes no judgement on the holding.

made.oewn-02340278-s.label: positive

family.axis: a favorable outcome stated as plain fact → success loud enough to be proclaimed

made.oewn-02340278-s.tone: Blunt finality: the success is banked and out of doubt, unlike *sure-fire*, which is confident about what has yet to happen.

no-hit.oewn-02340413-s.label: neutral

family.axis: a favorable outcome stated as plain fact → success loud enough to be proclaimed

no-hit.oewn-02340413-s.tone: A technical description of what the pitching allowed, recording the fact where the rest of the family evaluates.

productive.oewn-02340596-s.label: positive

family.axis: a favorable outcome stated as plain fact → success loud enough to be proclaimed

productive.oewn-02340596-s.tone: Measured, almost accounting approval - results were yielded, with none of *boffo*'s noise about them.

productive.oewn-01871147-a.label: positive

family.axis: flat statement that something bears or can bear → praise for abundant yield

productive.oewn-01871147-a.tone: Plain approval of output that covers both actual yield and the bare capacity for it, where *prolific* insists the yield is already there.

self-made.oewn-02340696-s.label: positive

family.axis: a favorable outcome stated as plain fact → success loud enough to be proclaimed

self-made.oewn-02340696-s.tone: Approval aimed at the person rather than the outcome, crediting the effort behind the success.

sure-fire.oewn-02340837-s.label: positive

family.axis: a favorable outcome stated as plain fact → success loud enough to be proclaimed

sure-fire.oewn-02340837-s.tone: Confidence issued in advance, guaranteeing a success that *made* can already report as done.

amentiferous.oewn-01871590-s.label: neutral

family.axis: flat statement that something bears or can bear → praise for abundant yield

amentiferous.oewn-01871590-s.tone: Technical and classifying: it records that the plant carries catkins and offers no verdict at all on how much it yields.

amentaceous.oewn-01871590-s.label: neutral

family.axis: flat statement that something bears or can bear → praise for abundant yield

amentaceous.oewn-01871590-s.tone: Places a plant by the catkins that characterize it, as flatly as *amentiferous* and with as little praise in it.

arable.oewn-01871757-s.label: positive

family.axis: flat statement that something bears or can bear → praise for abundant yield

arable.oewn-01871757-s.tone: A settled favourable verdict on land, but only that it could be farmed well - potential where *rich* asserts the yield itself.

cultivable.oewn-01871757-s.label: positive

family.axis: flat statement that something bears or can bear → praise for abundant yield

cultivable.oewn-01871757-s.tone: States the same promise as *arable* transparently through the act of cultivating, so it reads as an open possibility rather than a standing classification of the land.

cultivatable.oewn-01871757-s.label: positive

family.axis: flat statement that something bears or can bear → praise for abundant yield

cultivatable.oewn-01871757-s.tone: Heavier and more literal than *cultivable*, claiming no more than that the work of cultivation can be done here.

tillable.oewn-01871757-s.label: positive

family.axis: flat statement that something bears or can bear → praise for abundant yield

tillable.oewn-01871757-s.tone: The most physical of the land words, tying the ground's promise to the labour of tilling it where *arable* keeps the judgement abstract.

fecund.oewn-01871917-s.label: positive

family.axis: flat statement that something bears or can bear → praise for abundant yield

fecund.oewn-01871917-s.tone: Elevated praise for a mind that generates abundantly, richer and more admiring than a flat *productive*.

fertile.oewn-01871917-s.label: positive

family.axis: flat statement that something bears or can bear → praise for abundant yield

fertile.oewn-01871917-s.tone: Praises a mind as ground ideas grow from - readiness and promise, where *prolific* counts what has actually come out of it.

prolific.oewn-01871917-s.label: positive

family.axis: flat statement that something bears or can bear → praise for abundant yield

prolific.oewn-01871917-s.tone: Admiration measured by sheer quantity of intellectual output, where *fecund* admires its richness instead.

fur-bearing.oewn-01872079-s.label: neutral

family.axis: flat statement that something bears or can bear → praise for abundant yield

fur-bearing.oewn-01872079-s.tone: Coolly appraising rather than approving - it marks an animal as carrying fur worth having, without any compliment to the animal.

nut-bearing.oewn-01872193-s.label: neutral

family.axis: flat statement that something bears or can bear → praise for abundant yield

nut-bearing.oewn-01872193-s.tone: A bare compound naming what the plant puts out, with none of the claim about quantity that *productive* carries.

oil-bearing.oewn-01872286-s.label: neutral

family.axis: flat statement that something bears or can bear → praise for abundant yield

oil-bearing.oewn-01872286-s.tone: Says only that oil is present inside - containing rather than yielding, so nothing is being produced here at all.

rich.oewn-01872379-s.label: positive

family.axis: flat statement that something bears or can bear → praise for abundant yield

rich.oewn-01872379-s.tone: Short, everyday and emphatic, asserting abundance outright where *productive* still allows mere capacity.

impractical.oewn-01842067-a.label: negative

family.axis: unsuited to practical use → derided as senseless

impractical.oewn-01842067-a.tone: The plain term of the family - it states the unworkability and stops there, without the ridicule *crazy* and *half-baked* carry.

crazy.oewn-01842483-s.label: negative

family.axis: unsuited to practical use → derided as senseless

crazy.oewn-01842483-s.tone: Blunt and total - it leaves the notion nothing salvageable, where *impractical* leaves it merely unworkable.

crazy.oewn-00889690-s.label: positive

family.axis: plain keenness → enthusiasm intense enough to stop being creditable

crazy.oewn-00889690-s.tone: Informal, and the enthusiasm is put as a loss of one's senses - the overstatement is the compliment.

half-baked.oewn-01842483-s.label: negative

family.axis: unsuited to practical use → derided as senseless

half-baked.oewn-01842483-s.tone: Contemptuous - it casts the unsoundness as thinking abandoned before it was finished, faulting the effort as much as the result.

screwball.oewn-01842483-s.label: negative

family.axis: unsuited to practical use → derided as senseless

screwball.oewn-01842483-s.tone: Flippant - the foolishness is treated as entertaining eccentricity, so it stings less than *crazy* at the same verdict.

softheaded.oewn-01842483-s.label: negative

family.axis: unsuited to practical use → derided as senseless

softheaded.oewn-01842483-s.tone: Insulting in a way the others are not - it puts the unsoundness down to a mind too soft to hold a firm thought.

meshugge.oewn-01842742-s.label: negative

family.axis: unsuited to practical use → derided as senseless

meshugge.oewn-01842742-s.tone: Colloquial and flat - it calls the thing senseless outright, with none of the picture-making *half-baked* offers.

meshugga.oewn-01842742-s.label: negative

family.axis: unsuited to practical use → derided as senseless

meshugga.oewn-01842742-s.tone: A variant spelling of *meshugge* and no gentler for it - the same unadorned charge of senselessness.

meshuga.oewn-01842742-s.label: negative

family.axis: unsuited to practical use → derided as senseless

meshuga.oewn-01842742-s.tone: The barest of these spellings, and the shortness suits a word that makes no argument, only a verdict.

meshuggeneh.oewn-01842742-s.label: negative

family.axis: unsuited to practical use → derided as senseless

meshuggeneh.oewn-01842742-s.tone: The extra syllables give it a flourish the shorter spellings lack, but the judgement of senselessness is unchanged.

meshuggener.oewn-01842742-s.label: negative

family.axis: unsuited to practical use → derided as senseless

meshuggener.oewn-01842742-s.tone: Another form of the same dismissal - senselessness stated as settled fact, where *quixotic* would at least credit an aim.

quixotic.oewn-01842899-s.label: negative

family.axis: unsuited to practical use → derided as senseless

quixotic.oewn-01842899-s.tone: Faults the want of practical sense while crediting the ideals behind it, so the disapproval comes out half-admiring.

romantic.oewn-01842899-s.label: negative

family.axis: unsuited to practical use → derided as senseless

romantic.oewn-01842899-s.tone: The gentlest of these - the unrealism is charged to an idealizing temperament rather than a defect, and can be said almost fondly.

wild-eyed.oewn-01842899-s.label: negative

family.axis: unsuited to practical use → derided as senseless

wild-eyed.oewn-01842899-s.tone: Puts a look of fanaticism on the same unrealism, so where *romantic* indulges it this one warns against it.

unfunctional.oewn-01843204-s.label: neutral

family.axis: unsuited to practical use → derided as senseless

unfunctional.oewn-01843204-s.tone: Carries no verdict at all - it records unsuitability for everyday needs where *impractical* implies a fault.

unwieldy.oewn-01843322-s.label: negative

family.axis: unsuited to practical use → derided as senseless

unwieldy.oewn-01843322-s.tone: Locates the trouble in the handling rather than in anyone's judgement, so a thoroughly sensible thing can still earn it.

lost.oewn-01452455-a.label: negative

family.axis: temporarily out of place → gone for good through waste

lost.oewn-01452455-a.tone: The flat, final member - it puts a thing beyond holding and beyond recovery both, naming a deprivation rather than a mishap.

mislaid.oewn-01452757-s.label: neutral

family.axis: temporarily out of place → gone for good through waste

mislaid.oewn-01452757-s.tone: Gentlest here - the thing is still somewhere, merely not where it was put, so the loss is provisional and faintly self-excusing.

misplaced.oewn-01452757-s.label: neutral

family.axis: temporarily out of place → gone for good through waste

misplaced.oewn-01452757-s.tone: The same provisional loss as *mislaid* in a flatter, more formal register, faulting the position a thing ended up in rather than the act of setting it down.

missing.oewn-01452957-s.label: neutral

family.axis: temporarily out of place → gone for good through waste

missing.oewn-01452957-s.tone: Pure report of absence - it says only that the thing cannot be found, and unlike *lost* leaves recovery open.

squandered.oewn-01453072-s.label: negative

family.axis: temporarily out of place → gone for good through waste

squandered.oewn-01453072-s.tone: The condemning member - what was had was spent to no purpose, and the word insists someone did the spending.

wasted.oewn-01453072-s.label: negative

family.axis: temporarily out of place → gone for good through waste

wasted.oewn-01453072-s.tone: Registers value come to nothing without fixing on a culprit, which is the accusation *squandered* adds.

stray.oewn-01453222-s.label: negative

family.axis: temporarily out of place → gone for good through waste

stray.oewn-01453222-s.tone: Of an animal, and it covers both the one with no home and the one that has wandered off, carrying pity and a touch of nuisance at once.

straying.oewn-01453386-s.label: neutral

family.axis: temporarily out of place → gone for good through waste

straying.oewn-01453386-s.tone: Names only the predicament of being unable to find your way - a passing disorientation beside the standing state *stray* describes, with no blame in it.

dangerous.oewn-02066198-a.label: neutral

family.axis: outcome merely left to chance → grave or deliberately aimed danger

dangerous.oewn-02066198-a.tone: Flat and unarguable - it states that harm can follow and leaves the judging to someone else, where *unsafe* already faults the thing.

unsafe.oewn-02066198-a.label: negative

family.axis: outcome merely left to chance → grave or deliberately aimed danger

unsafe.oewn-02066198-a.tone: Measures the thing against a standard of safety it fails, so the danger arrives with a fault attached that *dangerous* leaves off.

unsafe.oewn-02534602-s.label: negative

family.axis: open to attack in principle → already taking the attack

unsafe.oewn-02534602-s.tone: The blunt everyday form of the same adverse judgement, stating the danger without locating the weakness as *insecure* does.

breakneck.oewn-02066684-s.label: neutral

family.axis: outcome merely left to chance → grave or deliberately aimed danger

breakneck.oewn-02066684-s.tone: The danger sits in the picture rather than in any verdict - a pace fast enough to break a neck, which can sound thrilling as readily as reckless.

chancy.oewn-02066785-s.label: negative

family.axis: outcome merely left to chance → grave or deliberately aimed danger

chancy.oewn-02066785-s.tone: Informal and shrugging - the outcome is handed to luck, which is enough to mark the thing as not worth counting on.

chanceful.oewn-02066785-s.label: neutral

family.axis: outcome merely left to chance → grave or deliberately aimed danger

chanceful.oewn-02066785-s.tone: The bare formation, saying only that an outcome is full of chance, without the wariness *chancy* packs into the same idea.

dicey.oewn-02066785-s.label: negative

family.axis: outcome merely left to chance → grave or deliberately aimed danger

dicey.oewn-02066785-s.tone: Informal, with a gambler's wince in it - the odds are being felt rather than merely noted.

dodgy.oewn-02066785-s.label: negative

family.axis: outcome merely left to chance → grave or deliberately aimed danger

dodgy.oewn-02066785-s.tone: British and dismissive - the thing is not just uncertain but not to be relied on, the most distrustful way of putting the same risk.

desperate.oewn-02067030-s.label: negative

family.axis: outcome merely left to chance → grave or deliberately aimed danger

desperate.oewn-02067030-s.tone: Aimed at a person rather than a situation - past caution and liable to violence, and the despair behind it does nothing to soften the warning.

hazardous.oewn-02067215-s.label: neutral

family.axis: outcome merely left to chance → grave or deliberately aimed danger

hazardous.oewn-02067215-s.tone: Formal and classifying - it registers danger as a property to be assessed, cooler than *risky*, which sounds like advice.

risky.oewn-02067215-s.label: neutral

family.axis: outcome merely left to chance → grave or deliberately aimed danger

risky.oewn-02067215-s.tone: Everyday and weighing - it frames the danger as something one might knowingly take on, where *hazardous* only labels it.

wild.oewn-02067215-s.label: neutral

family.axis: outcome merely left to chance → grave or deliberately aimed danger

wild.oewn-02067215-s.tone: Relishes the danger instead of warning against it, giving the same risk a heat that *hazardous* keeps out.

wild.oewn-00889690-s.label: positive

family.axis: plain keenness → enthusiasm intense enough to stop being creditable

wild.oewn-00889690-s.tone: Enthusiasm as sheer unrestrained force, less self-mocking than *crazy* and more like something the enthusiast cannot rein in.

insidious.oewn-02067510-s.label: negative

family.axis: outcome merely left to chance → grave or deliberately aimed danger

insidious.oewn-02067510-s.tone: Condemns outright, because here the danger is designed - something is laying a trap, and the word says so.

mordacious.oewn-02067602-s.label: negative

family.axis: outcome merely left to chance → grave or deliberately aimed danger

mordacious.oewn-02067602-s.tone: Formal and dry for something with teeth - it will serve for the act of biting or for the disposition toward it.

on_the_hook.oewn-02067763-s.label: neutral

family.axis: outcome merely left to chance → grave or deliberately aimed danger

on_the_hook.oewn-02067763-s.tone: Informal, and the image does the work: the danger is a trap someone is caught in rather than a failing of theirs.

parlous.oewn-02067900-s.label: neutral

family.axis: outcome merely left to chance → grave or deliberately aimed danger

parlous.oewn-02067900-s.tone: Heightened and declamatory - it announces danger with a flourish that *perilous* manages without.

perilous.oewn-02067900-s.label: neutral

family.axis: outcome merely left to chance → grave or deliberately aimed danger

perilous.oewn-02067900-s.tone: Grave and unironic - danger at full weight, more formal than *dangerous* and with none of the hedging in *chancy*.

different.oewn-02072149-a.label: neutral

family.axis: merely unlike → completely opposed

different.oewn-02072149-a.tone: The bare statement of unlikeness, fixing no degree — it says two things are not the same and stops there.

antithetic.oewn-02072808-s.label: neutral

family.axis: merely unlike → completely opposed

antithetic.oewn-02072808-s.tone: Casts the unlikeness as a matched opposition, two things defined against each other rather than merely unalike as in *different*.

antithetical.oewn-02072808-s.label: neutral

family.axis: merely unlike → completely opposed

antithetical.oewn-02072808-s.tone: The fuller and weightier-sounding form beside *antithetic*, carrying the same sense of two things set squarely against each other.

assorted.oewn-02073069-s.label: neutral

family.axis: merely unlike → completely opposed

assorted.oewn-02073069-s.tone: Turns difference into a made mixture — the variety is arranged, though nothing in it matches.

various.oewn-02073069-s.label: neutral

family.axis: merely unlike → completely opposed

various.oewn-02073069-s.tone: Spreads the same idea across the kinds themselves, a plural of difference, where *assorted* keeps attention on the mixing.

contrary.oewn-02073362-s.label: neutral

family.axis: merely unlike → completely opposed

contrary.oewn-02073362-s.tone: Marks unlikeness strong enough to amount to opposition, past the plain difference of *different* but short of the total inversion of *diametric*.

contrasting.oewn-02073546-s.label: neutral

family.axis: merely unlike → completely opposed

contrasting.oewn-02073546-s.tone: Makes the difference visible — the unlikeness is what strikes you when the two are set side by side.

contrastive.oewn-02073546-s.label: neutral

family.axis: merely unlike → completely opposed

contrastive.oewn-02073546-s.tone: Frames that same striking unlikeness as a property a thing has rather than an effect it produces, the more analytic-sounding of the pair with *contrasting*.

diametric.oewn-02073716-s.label: neutral

family.axis: merely unlike → completely opposed

diametric.oewn-02073716-s.tone: Puts the two at opposite ends of a single line, so the difference is total rather than merely sharp as in *contrasting*.

diametrical.oewn-02073716-s.label: neutral

family.axis: merely unlike → completely opposed

diametrical.oewn-02073716-s.tone: The extended form of *diametric*, identical in force and a shade more formal in shape.

opposite.oewn-02073716-s.label: neutral

family.axis: merely unlike → completely opposed

opposite.oewn-02073716-s.tone: The plainest way to state complete opposition, where *diametric* and *polar* dress the same total reversal in a figure.

polar.oewn-02073716-s.label: neutral

family.axis: merely unlike → completely opposed

polar.oewn-02073716-s.tone: Renders the opposition as two extremes with nothing between them, giving the contrast a fixed maximum that *contrary* leaves open-ended.

divergent.oewn-02074066-s.label: neutral

family.axis: merely unlike → completely opposed

divergent.oewn-02074066-s.tone: Makes the difference a moving apart rather than a settled state, and lets a standard be the thing departed from, where *disparate* simply finds two things unlike.

disparate.oewn-02074240-s.label: neutral

family.axis: merely unlike → completely opposed

disparate.oewn-02074240-s.tone: Places the unlikeness at the root — a difference of kind rather than of degree, deeper than the surface difference of *different*.

distinct.oewn-02074467-s.label: neutral

family.axis: merely unlike → completely opposed

distinct.oewn-02074467-s.tone: States the unlikeness as a clean separation of one thing from another, without any of the extremity of *diametric*.

distinguishable.oewn-02074467-s.label: neutral

family.axis: merely unlike → completely opposed

distinguishable.oewn-02074467-s.tone: Puts the same unlikeness in terms of what can be told apart, so the difference is one that survives inspection, where *distinct* just asserts it.

enthusiastic.oewn-00888937-a.label: positive

family.axis: plain keenness → enthusiasm intense enough to stop being creditable

enthusiastic.oewn-00888937-a.tone: The plain term for the state - it reports the excitement and interest without ruling on whether they are deserved, which is exactly what *overenthusiastic* rules on.

ardent.oewn-00889359-s.label: positive

family.axis: plain keenness → enthusiasm intense enough to stop being creditable

ardent.oewn-00889359-s.tone: Enthusiasm with heat in it, steady and burning rather than merely eager, where *warm* only glows.

warm.oewn-00889359-s.label: positive

family.axis: plain keenness → enthusiasm intense enough to stop being creditable

warm.oewn-00889359-s.tone: The mildest way to call enthusiasm strong - felt and unmistakable, but temperate beside *ardent*.

avid.oewn-00889495-s.label: positive

family.axis: plain keenness → enthusiasm intense enough to stop being creditable

avid.oewn-00889495-s.tone: Enthusiasm with appetite in it: the interest is active and reaches for more of what it likes.

zealous.oewn-00889495-s.label: positive

family.axis: plain keenness → enthusiasm intense enough to stop being creditable

zealous.oewn-00889495-s.tone: The same active interest as *avid*, hardened into commitment - an edge that can read as admirable drive or as too much of it.

dotty.oewn-00889690-s.label: neutral

family.axis: plain keenness → enthusiasm intense enough to stop being creditable

dotty.oewn-00889690-s.tone: Informal and British; it makes the preoccupation faintly comic without actually condemning it.

gaga.oewn-00889690-s.label: negative

family.axis: plain keenness → enthusiasm intense enough to stop being creditable

gaga.oewn-00889690-s.tone: Informal, and the least flattering of the preoccupied words - the enthusiasm has swamped the wits and left the enthusiast looking foolish.

evangelical.oewn-00889973-s.label: positive

family.axis: plain keenness → enthusiasm intense enough to stop being creditable

evangelical.oewn-00889973-s.tone: Enthusiasm fastened to a cause rather than a taste, so it reads as conviction and not just liking.

evangelistic.oewn-00889973-s.label: positive

family.axis: plain keenness → enthusiasm intense enough to stop being creditable

evangelistic.oewn-00889973-s.tone: Carries the same cause-driven fervour as *evangelical* with the weight shifted onto pressing it outward rather than simply holding it.

glowing.oewn-00890096-s.label: positive

family.axis: plain keenness → enthusiasm intense enough to stop being creditable

glowing.oewn-00890096-s.tone: The enthusiasm is on the surface and radiating - warmly, unambiguously approving in a way *zealous* never is.

gung_ho.oewn-00890187-s.label: positive

family.axis: plain keenness → enthusiasm intense enough to stop being creditable

gung_ho.oewn-00890187-s.tone: Informal; enthusiasm welded to dedication and straining to be put to use, keener to act than to weigh.

overenthusiastic.oewn-00890272-s.label: negative

family.axis: plain keenness → enthusiasm intense enough to stop being creditable

overenthusiastic.oewn-00890272-s.tone: The one word here that passes judgement: it grants the enthusiasm and marks it as more than the occasion warranted.

obligatory.oewn-00851498-a.label: neutral

family.axis: expected by convention → binding with no escape

obligatory.oewn-00851498-a.tone: The family's plain statement that something binds, holding the moral and the legal together without saying which one is doing the work.

bounden.oewn-00851799-s.label: positive

family.axis: expected by convention → binding with no escape

bounden.oewn-00851799-s.tone: Formal and solemn — the duty is owned and honoured rather than enforced, where *compulsory* has a rule pressing from outside.

compulsory.oewn-00851890-s.label: negative

family.axis: expected by convention → binding with no escape

compulsory.oewn-00851890-s.tone: Lets the force show: the point is that you are made to, not merely that a rule exists, which is all *required* settles for.

mandatory.oewn-00851890-s.label: neutral

family.axis: expected by convention → binding with no escape

mandatory.oewn-00851890-s.tone: Flat and impersonal — the rule simply states itself, with none of the pressure *compulsory* puts on the person obeying.

required.oewn-00851890-s.label: neutral

family.axis: expected by convention → binding with no escape

required.oewn-00851890-s.tone: The plainest of these: it names the rule's demand and stops, dramatizing neither the force behind it nor the duty in it.

de_rigueur.oewn-00852103-s.label: neutral

family.axis: expected by convention → binding with no escape

de_rigueur.oewn-00852103-s.tone: Mannered, and the binding is social only — taste and custom hold it up, with nothing of the rule that stands behind *mandatory*.

imposed.oewn-00852262-s.label: negative

family.axis: expected by convention → binding with no escape

imposed.oewn-00852262-s.tone: Puts the source in view — an authority has laid this down — where *required* leaves the hand that requires unnamed.

incumbent_on.oewn-00852407-s.label: neutral

family.axis: expected by convention → binding with no escape

incumbent_on.oewn-00852407-s.tone: Formal and weighty, fastening the obligation onto whoever it rests upon instead of stating it as a general rule the way *mandatory* does.

indispensable.oewn-00852532-s.label: neutral

family.axis: expected by convention → binding with no escape

indispensable.oewn-00852532-s.tone: Shuts off escape: no exception or excuse gets you out of it, where *compulsory* claims only that a rule stands behind the demand.

prerequisite.oewn-00852656-s.label: neutral

family.axis: expected by convention → binding with no escape

prerequisite.oewn-00852656-s.tone: Purely positional — it orders things, marking what must be satisfied first, and passes no judgement on the obligation at all.

articulate.oewn-00151470-a.label: positive

family.axis: the bare capacity for speech → speech praised for its polish and force

articulate.oewn-00151470-a.tone: Plain approval of clear, easy expression - it credits a speaker with getting the thought out whole, without *eloquent*'s claim on beauty.

eloquent.oewn-00151773-s.label: positive

family.axis: the bare capacity for speech → speech praised for its polish and force

eloquent.oewn-00151773-s.tone: The strongest praise in the family - expression so ready and effective that the manner of it is admired alongside the matter.

facile.oewn-00151773-s.label: positive

family.axis: the bare capacity for speech → speech praised for its polish and force

facile.oewn-00151773-s.tone: A cool compliment: it names the effortlessness of the speaking and stops there, where *eloquent* reaches for admiration.

fluent.oewn-00151773-s.label: positive

family.axis: the bare capacity for speech → speech praised for its polish and force

fluent.oewn-00151773-s.tone: Praise for speech that runs without a catch in it - flow, where *eloquent* claims power.

silver.oewn-00151773-s.label: positive

family.axis: the bare capacity for speech → speech praised for its polish and force

silver.oewn-00151773-s.tone: Figurative and frankly ornamental - it admires the sound of the speaking, where *articulate* admires only its clarity.

silver-tongued.oewn-00151773-s.label: positive

family.axis: the bare capacity for speech → speech praised for its polish and force

silver-tongued.oewn-00151773-s.tone: The figure spelled out at full length, praise with a flourish that plain *fluent* never attempts.

smooth-spoken.oewn-00151773-s.label: positive

family.axis: the bare capacity for speech → speech praised for its polish and force

smooth-spoken.oewn-00151773-s.tone: Approving of the delivery itself - words that arrive without friction - and plainer in register than *eloquent*.

speech-endowed.oewn-00152103-s.label: neutral

family.axis: the bare capacity for speech → speech praised for its polish and force

speech-endowed.oewn-00152103-s.tone: Purely descriptive and formal: it records the capacity to speak and passes no verdict on how well.

speaking.oewn-00152103-s.label: neutral

family.axis: the bare capacity for speech → speech praised for its polish and force

speaking.oewn-00152103-s.tone: The bare fact of having speech at all, carrying none of the approval that *articulate* does.

well-spoken.oewn-00152204-s.label: positive

family.axis: the bare capacity for speech → speech praised for its polish and force

well-spoken.oewn-00152204-s.tone: Approves speech that fits the occasion and pleases the ear, judging fitness as much as skill, where *fluent* asks only that the words come easily.

meaningless.oewn-01501055-a.label: negative

family.axis: flat statement that meaning is absent → contemptuous dismissal of a thing as void of it

meaningless.oewn-01501055-a.tone: Plain on the surface and bleak underneath, since it withholds direction and purpose along with sense, condemning where *nonmeaningful* only records.

nonmeaningful.oewn-01501055-a.label: neutral

family.axis: flat statement that meaning is absent → contemptuous dismissal of a thing as void of it

nonmeaningful.oewn-01501055-a.tone: Colourless and technical, it notes the absence and adds no dismay to it, where *meaningless* sounds the loss.

empty.oewn-01501421-s.label: negative

family.axis: flat statement that meaning is absent → contemptuous dismissal of a thing as void of it

empty.oewn-01501421-s.tone: A deflating verdict rather than a scornful one, saying only that nothing of weight is there and leaving the sneer to *vacuous*.

hollow.oewn-01501421-s.label: negative

family.axis: flat statement that meaning is absent → contemptuous dismissal of a thing as void of it

hollow.oewn-01501421-s.tone: The outward form is intact and the inside is not, so it carries a ring of sham that flat *empty* does not.

vacuous.oewn-01501421-s.label: negative

family.axis: flat statement that meaning is absent → contemptuous dismissal of a thing as void of it

vacuous.oewn-01501421-s.tone: The withering member of the three: formal, and it treats the missing force as a fault rather than a fact.

insignificant.oewn-01501635-s.label: negative

family.axis: flat statement that meaning is absent → contemptuous dismissal of a thing as void of it

insignificant.oewn-01501635-s.tone: A cool dismissal of what a thing stands for rather than of its size or loudness, drier and less final than *nonsensical*.

mindless.oewn-01501755-s.label: neutral

family.axis: flat statement that meaning is absent → contemptuous dismissal of a thing as void of it

mindless.oewn-01501755-s.tone: Descriptive rather than damning in this sense, stating an absence of thinking capacity without laying blame, where *nonsensical* passes judgement on what was produced.

nonsense.oewn-01501931-s.label: negative

family.axis: flat statement that meaning is absent → contemptuous dismissal of a thing as void of it

nonsense.oewn-01501931-s.tone: Blunt and unadorned, refusing the thing any intelligible sense without softening the refusal.

nonsensical.oewn-01501931-s.label: negative

family.axis: flat statement that meaning is absent → contemptuous dismissal of a thing as void of it

nonsensical.oewn-01501931-s.tone: The fuller, more formal judgement that nothing can be made of the thing at all, weightier in the mouth than blunt *nonsense*.

unmeaning.oewn-01502106-s.label: neutral

family.axis: flat statement that meaning is absent → contemptuous dismissal of a thing as void of it

unmeaning.oewn-01502106-s.tone: The plainest statement in the family, that meaning is simply absent, with none of the scorn *vacuous* or *nonsensical* carry.

favorable.oewn-00999158-a.label: positive

family.axis: quietly well-disposed → openly voiced praise

favorable.oewn-00999158-a.tone: The broadest approval here, covering a disposition, a sign or an outcome alike, and unlike *approving* it never requires the approval to be spoken.

favourable.oewn-00999158-a.label: positive

family.axis: quietly well-disposed → openly voiced praise

favourable.oewn-00999158-a.tone: The British spelling, carrying exactly the force of *favorable* and adding nothing to it.

approving.oewn-00999508-s.label: positive

family.axis: quietly well-disposed → openly voiced praise

approving.oewn-00999508-s.tone: The plain word for approval that shows — in a look, a tone or a word — where *favorable* can stay unexpressed.

affirmative.oewn-00999508-s.label: positive

family.axis: quietly well-disposed → openly voiced praise

affirmative.oewn-00999508-s.tone: Cooler than *approving*: the praise arrives as endorsement, stated rather than warmly felt.

approbative.oewn-00999508-s.label: positive

family.axis: quietly well-disposed → openly voiced praise

approbative.oewn-00999508-s.tone: Formal to the point of stiffness — the same praise as *approving* lifted into an official register.

approbatory.oewn-00999508-s.label: positive

family.axis: quietly well-disposed → openly voiced praise

approbatory.oewn-00999508-s.tone: A near-twin of *approbative* in force, ceremonious enough that the praise reads as conferred rather than simply shown.

plausive.oewn-00999508-s.label: positive

family.axis: quietly well-disposed → openly voiced praise

plausive.oewn-00999508-s.tone: Literary and heightened, its praise closer to applause than to the bare assent of *affirmative*.

indulgent.oewn-00999762-s.label: positive

family.axis: quietly well-disposed → openly voiced praise

indulgent.oewn-00999762-s.tone: The mildest of these — a leaning in someone's favour rather than praise of any kind, so nothing need be expressed as it must with *approving*.

destroyed.oewn-00737862-a.label: neutral

family.axis: partly spoiled but still there → reduced to nothing

destroyed.oewn-00737862-a.tone: The elastic member: it stretches from merely spoiled to flattened, so it fixes that ruin happened without fixing how much is left, where *annihilated* leaves nothing to measure.

annihilated.oewn-00738342-s.label: neutral

family.axis: partly spoiled but still there → reduced to nothing

annihilated.oewn-00738342-s.tone: Absolute where *destroyed* is elastic - it admits no remnant and no degree, and its sweep makes the ruin sound total rather than merely thorough.

exterminated.oewn-00738342-s.label: negative

family.axis: partly spoiled but still there → reduced to nothing

exterminated.oewn-00738342-s.tone: Carries a purpose *annihilated* does not: the completeness is somebody's work, and the word frames what it names as a thing that was to be got rid of.

wiped_out.oewn-00738342-s.label: neutral

family.axis: partly spoiled but still there → reduced to nothing

wiped_out.oewn-00738342-s.tone: The informal member, and the offhand phrasing makes the same completeness sound quick and easy rather than momentous beside *annihilated*.

blighted.oewn-00738450-s.label: negative

family.axis: partly spoiled but still there → reduced to nothing

blighted.oewn-00738450-s.tone: Ruin as a slow affliction rather than an event - what it marks is not smashed but stopped, held back from growing or prospering again.

spoilt.oewn-00738450-s.label: negative

family.axis: partly spoiled but still there → reduced to nothing

spoilt.oewn-00738450-s.tone: British in spelling and the milder half of its pair: the good has gone out of the thing, where *blighted* adds that nothing will come of it now.

blotted_out.oewn-00738632-s.label: neutral

family.axis: partly spoiled but still there → reduced to nothing

blotted_out.oewn-00738632-s.tone: Nothingness reached by covering over: the thing is effaced rather than smashed, which makes this the visual member beside the formal *obliterated*.

obliterate.oewn-00738632-s.label: neutral

family.axis: partly spoiled but still there → reduced to nothing

obliterate.oewn-00738632-s.tone: The bare adjectival form states the finished nothingness flatly, without the backward glance at whatever caused it that *obliterated* keeps.

obliterated.oewn-00738632-s.label: neutral

family.axis: partly spoiled but still there → reduced to nothing

obliterated.oewn-00738632-s.tone: Formal and cold next to *blotted out*: the participle points back at an act, and what is left is nothing at all rather than something hidden.

impoverished.oewn-00738739-s.label: neutral

family.axis: partly spoiled but still there → reduced to nothing

impoverished.oewn-00738739-s.tone: The formal word for that same ruin: it names the poverty left behind rather than the break itself, so it sounds like a settled condition where *broken* sounds like a moment.

burned.oewn-00738880-s.label: neutral

family.axis: partly spoiled but still there → reduced to nothing

burned.oewn-00738880-s.tone: Reaches from scorched to gone, fixing fire as the cause while leaving open how much survives - which the compounds beside it refuse to leave open.

burnt.oewn-00738880-s.label: neutral

family.axis: partly spoiled but still there → reduced to nothing

burnt.oewn-00738880-s.tone: The clipped form, and the shorter shape makes it read as a property the thing now has rather than a report of what happened to it, as *burned* does.

burned-over.oewn-00738880-s.label: neutral

family.axis: partly spoiled but still there → reduced to nothing

burned-over.oewn-00738880-s.tone: The particle puts the fire's passage across the thing: it names what the flames swept and left behind them, not what they consumed.

burned-out.oewn-00738880-s.label: neutral

family.axis: partly spoiled but still there → reduced to nothing

burned-out.oewn-00738880-s.tone: Says the fire went to its end from the inside and left a hollow behind - more final than plain *burned*, and short of gone.

burnt-out.oewn-00738880-s.label: neutral

family.axis: partly spoiled but still there → reduced to nothing

burnt-out.oewn-00738880-s.tone: The clipped twin of *burned-out*, its tighter shape making the hollowness sound like the thing's condition now rather than the fire's doing.

stylish.oewn-00978362-a.label: positive

family.axis: unshowy good taste → style that announces itself

stylish.oewn-00978362-a.tone: Plain approval of taste itself - the elegance is credited to the person's own eye rather than to anything they have matched.

fashionable.oewn-00978362-a.label: positive

family.axis: unshowy good taste → style that announces itself

fashionable.oewn-00978362-a.tone: Treats the elegance as a standard met rather than a judgement shown, which is what holds it a step below *stylish*.

chic.oewn-00978678-s.label: positive

family.axis: unshowy good taste → style that announces itself

chic.oewn-00978678-s.tone: Sleek and assured - it praises elegance that looks effortless, where *smart* praises elegance that looks attended to.

smart.oewn-00978678-s.label: positive

family.axis: unshowy good taste → style that announces itself

smart.oewn-00978678-s.tone: Crisp, unfussy praise for trimness and polish, without the flair *chic* lays claim to.

voguish.oewn-00978678-s.label: positive

family.axis: unshowy good taste → style that announces itself

voguish.oewn-00978678-s.tone: Approval held slightly at arm's length - the *-ish* keeps it from committing the way *chic* does.

chichi.oewn-00978883-s.label: negative

family.axis: unshowy good taste → style that announces itself

chichi.oewn-00978883-s.tone: Derisive - the style is a pose being struck, so the word withholds the very compliment *chic* pays.

classy.oewn-00978969-s.label: positive

family.axis: unshowy good taste → style that announces itself

classy.oewn-00978969-s.tone: Warm, informal approval that grants elegance outright, without the cool appraisal running under *chic*.

posh.oewn-00978969-s.label: positive

family.axis: unshowy good taste → style that announces itself

posh.oewn-00978969-s.tone: British, and the admiration is broad and hearty - it takes in the whole impression rather than any fineness of judgement.

swish.oewn-00978969-s.label: positive

family.axis: unshowy good taste → style that announces itself

swish.oewn-00978969-s.tone: Informal and breezy - admiration blurted rather than weighed, lighter on its feet than *classy*.

snazzy.oewn-00979207-s.label: positive

family.axis: unshowy good taste → style that announces itself

snazzy.oewn-00979207-s.tone: Playful approval with the flash left in - it enjoys the show that *chic* would find excessive.

vulnerable.oewn-02533434-a.label: neutral

family.axis: open to attack in principle → already taking the attack

vulnerable.oewn-02533434-a.tone: The family's flat baseline: it registers that an attack could land without saying anything is missing or anyone is at fault.

assailable.oewn-02533823-s.label: neutral

family.axis: open to attack in principle → already taking the attack

assailable.oewn-02533823-s.tone: Formal and analytic, looking from the attacker's side at what can be gone after, where *undefended* only reports what is not there.

undefendable.oewn-02533823-s.label: neutral

family.axis: open to attack in principle → already taking the attack

undefendable.oewn-02533823-s.tone: Puts the weight on impossibility - not that defences are absent but that none could be made to hold.

undefended.oewn-02533823-s.label: neutral

family.axis: open to attack in principle → already taking the attack

undefended.oewn-02533823-s.tone: Bare report of an absence, with no claim that defence was tried or that it could have worked.

open.oewn-02533823-s.label: neutral

family.axis: open to attack in principle → already taking the attack

open.oewn-02533823-s.tone: The mildest wording for the same state, naming the gap as a plain fact of position rather than the failure *undefendable* implies.

compromising.oewn-02534026-s.label: negative

family.axis: open to attack in principle → already taking the attack

compromising.oewn-02534026-s.tone: The one member whose danger is to standing rather than to body - exposure that invites suspicion and discredit.

defenseless.oewn-02534191-s.label: negative

family.axis: open to attack in principle → already taking the attack

defenseless.oewn-02534191-s.tone: Pitying - the subject is helpless and unsupplied, where *undefended* notes only the absence.

defenceless.oewn-02534191-s.label: negative

family.axis: open to attack in principle → already taking the attack

defenceless.oewn-02534191-s.tone: British spelling, identical in force: helplessness rather than the neutral gap *undefended* reports.

endangered.oewn-02534351-s.label: neutral

family.axis: open to attack in principle → already taking the attack

endangered.oewn-02534351-s.tone: A graded status term rather than a verdict, and the severe end of that grading - extinction imminent, not merely likely.

indefensible.oewn-02534504-s.label: negative

family.axis: open to attack in principle → already taking the attack

indefensible.oewn-02534504-s.tone: Absolute here: no protection could hold, a harder claim than *undefended*'s report that none is in place.

insecure.oewn-02534602-s.label: negative

family.axis: open to attack in principle → already taking the attack

insecure.oewn-02534602-s.tone: Treats the exposure as a standing property of the thing's condition, an adverse mark rather than a neutral gap.

penetrable.oewn-02534722-s.label: neutral

family.axis: open to attack in principle → already taking the attack

penetrable.oewn-02534722-s.tone: Purely a property of the barrier - it says what can be got through, with no suggestion that anything is coming through.

threatened.oewn-02534847-s.label: neutral

family.axis: open to attack in principle → already taking the attack

threatened.oewn-02534847-s.tone: The graded step below *endangered*: likelihood of peril soon rather than peril arrived.

under_attack.oewn-02535059-s.label: neutral

family.axis: open to attack in principle → already taking the attack

under_attack.oewn-02535059-s.tone: Shifts from susceptibility to fact - the blows are landing, and they can be censure as readily as weapons.

under_fire.oewn-02535059-s.label: neutral

family.axis: open to attack in principle → already taking the attack

under_fire.oewn-02535059-s.tone: The vivid twin of *under attack*, its gunfire image carrying the same double reach over assault and criticism.

interesting.oewn-01346766-a.label: positive

family.axis: attention pleasantly held → attention seized and fixed

interesting.oewn-01346766-a.tone: The flattest word here - it grants that attention is held and says nothing about how hard, which *absorbing* and *riveting* both do.

absorbing.oewn-01347019-s.label: positive

family.axis: attention pleasantly held → attention seized and fixed

absorbing.oewn-01347019-s.tone: The hold is inward and quiet, attention drawn in rather than seized as by *gripping*.

engrossing.oewn-01347019-s.label: positive

family.axis: attention pleasantly held → attention seized and fixed

engrossing.oewn-01347019-s.tone: Stronger than *absorbing*: attention is not merely drawn in but wholly occupied, with nothing left over.

fascinating.oewn-01347019-s.label: positive

family.axis: attention pleasantly held → attention seized and fixed

fascinating.oewn-01347019-s.tone: The hold works like a spell - attention is charmed into staying rather than pinned there as by *riveting*.

gripping.oewn-01347019-s.label: positive

family.axis: attention pleasantly held → attention seized and fixed

gripping.oewn-01347019-s.tone: Physical in its force - attention is taken hold of rather than invited, where *fascinating* wins it.

riveting.oewn-01347019-s.label: positive

family.axis: attention pleasantly held → attention seized and fixed

riveting.oewn-01347019-s.tone: The most immobilising of these - attention is fixed in place, not merely drawn in as by *absorbing*.

entertaining.oewn-01347192-s.label: positive

family.axis: attention pleasantly held → attention seized and fixed

entertaining.oewn-01347192-s.tone: Light approval - it promises agreeable diversion rather than the deep hold *engrossing* claims.

amusing.oewn-01347333-s.label: positive

family.axis: attention pleasantly held → attention seized and fixed

amusing.oewn-01347333-s.tone: Warm and easy - the praise is for the pleasure given, not for any grip on attention of the kind *gripping* asserts.

amusive.oewn-01347333-s.label: positive

family.axis: attention pleasantly held → attention seized and fixed

amusive.oewn-01347333-s.tone: The stiffer, more formal shape beside *amusing*, claiming the same pleasure with less warmth in the saying.

diverting.oewn-01347333-s.label: positive

family.axis: attention pleasantly held → attention seized and fixed

diverting.oewn-01347333-s.tone: Understated praise - the enjoyment is framed as a pleasant turning-aside, milder than *amusing*.

intriguing.oewn-01347532-s.label: positive

family.axis: attention pleasantly held → attention seized and fixed

intriguing.oewn-01347532-s.tone: The pull is curiosity rather than pleasure - it promises something not yet given, where *fascinating* holds you with what it shows.

newsworthy.oewn-01347682-s.label: neutral

family.axis: attention pleasantly held → attention seized and fixed

newsworthy.oewn-01347682-s.tone: A threshold rather than a compliment - it measures whether interest clears the bar for reporting, where the rest of the family reports the pull itself.

inadequate.oewn-00051936-a.label: negative

family.axis: a shortfall merely counted → a fitness condemned

inadequate.oewn-00051936-a.tone: The flat general word for falling short of what a task demands, registering the shortfall without turning it on whoever bears it.

unequal.oewn-00051936-a.label: negative

family.axis: a shortfall merely counted → a fitness condemned

unequal.oewn-00051936-a.tone: Weighs what is brought against what the task takes and finds the two mismatched, where *inadequate* names the shortfall as a defect in the thing itself.

deficient.oewn-00052252-s.label: negative

family.axis: a shortfall merely counted → a fitness condemned

deficient.oewn-00052252-s.tone: Cool and quantitative - a measured shortfall below the amount or degree required, with none of the verdict *wanting* carries.

lacking.oewn-00052252-s.label: negative

family.axis: a shortfall merely counted → a fitness condemned

lacking.oewn-00052252-s.tone: The plainest of these, naming the missing amount outright and stopping there.

wanting.oewn-00052252-s.label: negative

family.axis: a shortfall merely counted → a fitness condemned

wanting.oewn-00052252-s.tone: Formal and weighted, as though the amount had been tested against a standard and pronounced short, where *lacking* only reports the gap.

incapable.oewn-00052486-s.label: negative

family.axis: a shortfall merely counted → a fitness condemned

incapable.oewn-00052486-s.tone: Puts the unmet requirement down to capacity - not that the standard was missed but that it could not be reached.

incompetent.oewn-00052486-s.label: negative

family.axis: a shortfall merely counted → a fitness condemned

incompetent.oewn-00052486-s.tone: The harshest here, reading a missed requirement as a verdict on fitness rather than a measurement of it.

unequal_to.oewn-00052486-s.label: negative

family.axis: a shortfall merely counted → a fitness condemned

unequal_to.oewn-00052486-s.tone: The gentlest way of saying the requirement went unmet, setting the demand beside the resource and leaving the failure unassigned where *incompetent* pins it.

short-handed.oewn-00052671-s.label: neutral

family.axis: a shortfall merely counted → a fitness condemned

short-handed.oewn-00052671-s.tone: Informal, and it carries the strain of working a job with too few hands rather than the bare count.

short-staffed.oewn-00052671-s.label: neutral

family.axis: a shortfall merely counted → a fitness condemned

short-staffed.oewn-00052671-s.tone: States the shortfall as a plain condition of the staff on hand, neither excusing it nor blaming anyone for it.

undermanned.oewn-00052671-s.label: neutral

family.axis: a shortfall merely counted → a fitness condemned

undermanned.oewn-00052671-s.tone: Measures the people present against the strength the work was meant to have, framing the gap as a post held by too few.

understaffed.oewn-00052671-s.label: neutral

family.axis: a shortfall merely counted → a fitness condemned

understaffed.oewn-00052671-s.tone: The flattest of the four - a headcount below requirement, without the felt pressure of *short-handed*.

diplomatic.oewn-00762004-a.label: positive

family.axis: surface smoothness of manner → felt sensitivity toward the person handled

diplomatic.oewn-00762004-a.tone: Credits the handling rather than the feeling - the praise is for skill that kept something sensitive from going wrong.

diplomatical.oewn-00762004-a.label: positive

family.axis: surface smoothness of manner → felt sensitivity toward the person handled

diplomatical.oewn-00762004-a.tone: The same praise in a longer, stiffer shape, where *diplomatic* carries it without the extra weight.

politic.oewn-00762345-s.label: positive

family.axis: surface smoothness of manner → felt sensitivity toward the person handled

politic.oewn-00762345-s.tone: Approval with calculation audible in it - the courtesy is graceful and also plainly chosen, where *tactful* sounds felt.

smooth.oewn-00762345-s.label: negative

family.axis: surface smoothness of manner → felt sensitivity toward the person handled

smooth.oewn-00762345-s.tone: The polish is the whole of it - agreeable with so little friction that you start looking for what is underneath.

suave.oewn-00762345-s.label: positive

family.axis: surface smoothness of manner → felt sensitivity toward the person handled

suave.oewn-00762345-s.tone: Puts the sophistication out front so the courtesy reads as elegance, where *smooth* makes it read as technique.

bland.oewn-00762345-s.label: negative

family.axis: surface smoothness of manner → felt sensitivity toward the person handled

bland.oewn-00762345-s.tone: Courtesy sanded down to inoffensiveness - agreeable because nothing is left to catch on.

tactful.oewn-00762714-s.label: positive

family.axis: surface smoothness of manner → felt sensitivity toward the person handled

tactful.oewn-00762714-s.tone: Warm where *politic* is shrewd - the skill is credited to sensitivity toward the person rather than to judgement about the situation.

kid-glove.oewn-00762714-s.label: positive

family.axis: surface smoothness of manner → felt sensitivity toward the person handled

kid-glove.oewn-00762714-s.tone: Makes the care visible as extreme gentleness, handling someone as though they might break, where *tactful* keeps the effort out of sight.

significant.oewn-02168847-a.label: neutral

family.axis: worth noticing → weighty enough to change the world

significant.oewn-02168847-a.tone: A flat measure of weight in effect or meaning, asserting that something counts without saying the counting is welcome.

important.oewn-02168847-a.label: positive

family.axis: worth noticing → weighty enough to change the world

important.oewn-02168847-a.tone: More insistent than *significant* — it claims the thing matters and should be treated accordingly, not merely that it registers.

momentous.oewn-02169397-s.label: positive

family.axis: worth noticing → weighty enough to change the world

momentous.oewn-02169397-s.tone: Lifts *significant* to a height where the weight itself is the point, grave and admiring at once.

epochal.oewn-02169594-s.label: positive

family.axis: worth noticing → weighty enough to change the world

epochal.oewn-02169594-s.tone: Adds a boundary to the weight: not just great effect but the opening of something new, which *momentous* never requires.

epoch-making.oewn-02169594-s.label: positive

family.axis: worth noticing → weighty enough to change the world

epoch-making.oewn-02169594-s.tone: The active twin of *epochal* — it credits the thing with making the new beginning rather than merely marking it.

earthshaking.oewn-02169873-s.label: positive

family.axis: worth noticing → weighty enough to change the world

earthshaking.oewn-02169873-s.tone: Trades gravity for reach — the effect is felt across the whole world, and the word keeps the physical jolt of its image.

world-shaking.oewn-02169873-s.label: positive

family.axis: worth noticing → weighty enough to change the world

world-shaking.oewn-02169873-s.tone: The same global reach as *earthshaking*, with the world named outright instead of shaken underfoot.

world-shattering.oewn-02169873-s.label: positive

family.axis: worth noticing → weighty enough to change the world

world-shattering.oewn-02169873-s.tone: The most violent of the three: the world does not shake but breaks, so the significance arrives as rupture.

evidential.oewn-02170148-s.label: neutral

family.axis: worth noticing → weighty enough to change the world

evidential.oewn-02170148-s.tone: Carries no appraisal at all — it marks only that something rests on or supplies evidence, so it sits outside any scale of weight.

evidentiary.oewn-02170148-s.label: neutral

family.axis: worth noticing → weighty enough to change the world

evidentiary.oewn-02170148-s.tone: The stiffer, more formal twin of *evidential*, and just as free of praise or blame.

fundamental.oewn-02170349-s.label: neutral

family.axis: worth noticing → weighty enough to change the world

fundamental.oewn-02170349-s.tone: Points downward rather than upward: the effect reaches what a thing is, describing depth of change instead of how much it is admired.

profound.oewn-02170349-s.label: positive

family.axis: worth noticing → weighty enough to change the world

profound.oewn-02170349-s.tone: Where *fundamental* is structural this one is grave, reaching the same way into a thing's nature but spoken with awe.

large.oewn-02170722-s.label: neutral

family.axis: worth noticing → weighty enough to change the world

large.oewn-02170722-s.tone: Deliberately unemphatic — it grants real effect and influence while stopping far short of *monumental*.

monumental.oewn-02170883-s.label: positive

family.axis: worth noticing → weighty enough to change the world

monumental.oewn-02170883-s.tone: Makes the significance imposing, something that stands over whatever is beside it, where *noteworthy* only asks you to look.

noteworthy.oewn-02171017-s.label: positive

family.axis: worth noticing → weighty enough to change the world

noteworthy.oewn-02171017-s.tone: A modest claim: it asks for attention and promises nothing beyond it.

remarkable.oewn-02171017-s.label: positive

family.axis: worth noticing → weighty enough to change the world

remarkable.oewn-02171017-s.tone: Stronger than *noteworthy* on the same ground — attention is compelled rather than merely deserved, and admiration comes with it.

tidy.oewn-02431459-a.label: positive

family.axis: bare absence of mess → admiring, kept-up order

tidy.oewn-02431459-a.tone: Mild, unemphatic approval that takes in habits as well as appearance, where *clean-cut* is a verdict on looks alone.

clean-cut.oewn-02431847-s.label: positive

family.axis: bare absence of mess → admiring, kept-up order

clean-cut.oewn-02431847-s.tone: Smartness with a sharp edge to it - the neatness reads as definition of outline, where *trim* praises proportion.

trig.oewn-02431847-s.label: positive

family.axis: bare absence of mess → admiring, kept-up order

trig.oewn-02431847-s.tone: Spruce and compact - the same smartness pulled tight, without *clean-cut*'s sharpness of line.

trim.oewn-02431847-s.label: positive

family.axis: bare absence of mess → admiring, kept-up order

trim.oewn-02431847-s.tone: Here the smartness is one of proportion, nothing loose and nothing spare, where *clean-cut* is about crispness.

neat.oewn-02432057-s.label: positive

family.axis: bare absence of mess → admiring, kept-up order

neat.oewn-02432057-s.tone: The plain word of approval for it - nothing out of place, where *orderly* wants an arrangement behind the tidiness.

orderly.oewn-02432057-s.label: positive

family.axis: bare absence of mess → admiring, kept-up order

orderly.oewn-02432057-s.tone: Credits the system rather than the surface: things are arranged, not merely unmessy as with *neat*.

ruly.oewn-02432336-s.label: positive

family.axis: bare absence of mess → admiring, kept-up order

ruly.oewn-02432336-s.tone: A quiet yes to tidiness with no appraisal in it, next to the brisk verdict of *shipshape*.

shipshape.oewn-02432422-s.label: positive

family.axis: bare absence of mess → admiring, kept-up order

shipshape.oewn-02432422-s.tone: The briskest approval in the family - order thorough enough that nothing is left to put right, where *neat* is satisfied with the surface.

well-kept.oewn-02432422-s.label: positive

family.axis: bare absence of mess → admiring, kept-up order

well-kept.oewn-02432422-s.tone: Praises the keeping as much as the state - the order reads as sustained, where *shipshape* praises how complete it is.

slicked_up.oewn-02432638-s.label: positive

family.axis: bare absence of mess → admiring, kept-up order

slicked_up.oewn-02432638-s.tone: Informal, and the tidiness is put on rather than native - a spruced state, where *well-kept* implies it never lapsed.

straight.oewn-02432754-s.label: positive

family.axis: bare absence of mess → admiring, kept-up order

straight.oewn-02432754-s.tone: The bare arrangement word - things put right, with none of the polish *shipshape* claims.

uncluttered.oewn-02432868-s.label: positive

family.axis: bare absence of mess → admiring, kept-up order

uncluttered.oewn-02432868-s.tone: Approves by subtraction, the merit lying in what is gone, where *neat* and *orderly* credit an arrangement.

unlittered.oewn-02432868-s.label: neutral

family.axis: bare absence of mess → admiring, kept-up order

unlittered.oewn-02432868-s.tone: Flatter than *uncluttered* - it denies mess rather than paying a compliment for its absence.

inconsistent.oewn-00580271-a.label: negative

family.axis: bare failure to match → outright contradiction

inconsistent.oewn-00580271-a.tone: The plain, unemphatic name for the fault - it marks a failure to hold together without saying how sharp the clash is.

at_odds.oewn-00580585-s.label: negative

family.axis: bare failure to match → outright contradiction

at_odds.oewn-00580585-s.tone: Idiomatic and comparatively mild - it frames the disagreement as two things standing opposed rather than as either one being wrong.

conflicting.oewn-00580585-s.label: negative

family.axis: bare failure to match → outright contradiction

conflicting.oewn-00580585-s.tone: Puts the two sides in active collision, stronger than *at odds* but stopping short of claiming they cannot both stand.

contradictory.oewn-00580585-s.label: negative

family.axis: bare failure to match → outright contradiction

contradictory.oewn-00580585-s.tone: The hardest of the disagreement words - it says the two cancel each other, so one of them has to go.

self-contradictory.oewn-00580585-s.label: negative

family.axis: bare failure to match → outright contradiction

self-contradictory.oewn-00580585-s.tone: Turns the clash inward so no second party is needed - the thing defeats itself, which is the more damning charge.

discrepant.oewn-00580874-s.label: negative

family.axis: bare failure to match → outright contradiction

discrepant.oewn-00580874-s.tone: Formal and measuring - it registers the mismatch against the facts coolly, where *incompatible* pronounces on it.

incompatible.oewn-00580874-s.label: negative

family.axis: bare failure to match → outright contradiction

incompatible.oewn-00580874-s.tone: States the mismatch as a settled property of the thing rather than an observation about it, blunter and more final than *discrepant*.

spotty.oewn-00581013-s.label: negative

family.axis: bare failure to match → outright contradiction

spotty.oewn-00581013-s.tone: Informal and deflating - it breaks the thing into good patches and bad ones, so the complaint carries a grudging concession inside it.

uneven.oewn-00581013-s.label: negative

family.axis: bare failure to match → outright contradiction

uneven.oewn-00581013-s.tone: The mildest of these - it registers variation without deciding that any part of the thing has failed.

scratchy.oewn-00581013-s.label: negative

family.axis: bare failure to match → outright contradiction

scratchy.oewn-00581013-s.tone: Informal and slighting - it allows the thing no smooth stretch at all, where *spotty* at least grants good patches between the bad.

unconformable.oewn-00581182-s.label: neutral

family.axis: bare failure to match → outright contradiction

unconformable.oewn-00581182-s.tone: Technical and unblaming - it records only that two things fail to correspond and leaves the fault unassigned.

unreconciled.oewn-00581311-s.label: neutral

family.axis: bare failure to match → outright contradiction

unreconciled.oewn-00581311-s.tone: Points at work left undone rather than at a defect - the clash simply stands, not declared unresolvable as *incompatible* would have it.

noticeable.oewn-01289803-a.label: neutral

family.axis: just barely made out → noticeable to the point of intruding

noticeable.oewn-01289803-a.tone: The plain, unjudged term of the set — it rates a thing as able or worth noticing without saying whether the noticing is welcome, which is exactly what *obtrusive* adds.

broad.oewn-01290162-s.label: neutral

family.axis: just barely made out → noticeable to the point of intruding

broad.oewn-01290162-s.tone: A speech word: it grades how thickly the regional colouring comes through, not how plainly a thing shows itself.

detectable.oewn-01290284-s.label: neutral

family.axis: just barely made out → noticeable to the point of intruding

detectable.oewn-01290284-s.tone: Near-instrumental in feel — it frames the thing as something a look or a test turns up, where *perceptible* frames it as something the senses take in.

perceptible.oewn-01290284-s.label: neutral

family.axis: just barely made out → noticeable to the point of intruding

perceptible.oewn-01290284-s.tone: Pitches the same easy visibility at the observer's senses rather than at a search, which is what sets it apart from *detectable*.

discernible.oewn-01290488-s.label: neutral

family.axis: just barely made out → noticeable to the point of intruding

discernible.oewn-01290488-s.tone: The most guarded of the three — it grants only that the thing can be picked out, without *evident*'s suggestion that it announces itself.

evident.oewn-01290488-s.label: neutral

family.axis: just barely made out → noticeable to the point of intruding

evident.oewn-01290488-s.tone: Stronger than *discernible* on the same footing: what is evident presents itself rather than waiting to be made out.

observable.oewn-01290488-s.label: neutral

family.axis: just barely made out → noticeable to the point of intruding

observable.oewn-01290488-s.tone: The flattest of the three — a bare statement that observation is possible, carrying none of *evident*'s force.

marked.oewn-01290810-s.label: neutral

family.axis: just barely made out → noticeable to the point of intruding

marked.oewn-01290810-s.tone: Raises the degree rather than the ease — the thing stands out by how strongly it is set off, not by how little effort finding it takes.

pronounced.oewn-01290810-s.label: neutral

family.axis: just barely made out → noticeable to the point of intruding

pronounced.oewn-01290810-s.tone: Carries the same heightened degree as *marked*, but with the sense of a quality pushed forward until it cannot be missed.

obtrusive.oewn-01290974-s.label: negative

family.axis: just barely made out → noticeable to the point of intruding

obtrusive.oewn-01290974-s.tone: The one member that judges: it puts the noticing at the top of the scale and calls it unwanted, where *marked* only measures how far the scale runs.
